articles.title_en: Migrating our Messages API to Rust
articles.title_zh: 将我们的消息 API 迁移到Rust
articles.summary_zh: 我们如何使用现有消息 API 来验证新消息，由 Claude 代理组成的团队跟踪并修复Python和Rust版本之间的差异。许多问题都存在生成器—验证者差距：通常，验证一个解是否正确要比构造出这样一个解容易得多。数独是一个经典例子。验证解法很简单（只需统计每一行、每一列和每一个宫格中的数字个数），但要找到这个解法却可能需要很长时间。许多雄心勃勃的 Claude 项目都依赖于这一差距: 形式化数学证明或迁移大型、经过良好测试的代码库是 Claude 可以承担的任务，只要它有可靠的方法来验证其工作。
articles.summary_en: How we used the existing Messages API to verify the new one, with teams of Claude agents tracking down and fixing differences between the Python and Rust versions. Many problems have a generator–verifier gap: it’s often far easier to verify that a solution is correct than to come up with one. Sudoku is a classic example. It’s simple to check the solution (just count the numbers in each row, column, and box), but finding that solution can take a long time. Many ambitious Claude projects have relied on this gap: formalizing proofs in mathematics or migrating large, well-tested codebases are tasks Claude can take on as long as it has a reliable way to verify its work.

articles.title_en: Turn artifacts into Mac and Windows apps
articles.title_zh: 将工件转换为Mac和Windows应用程序
articles.summary_zh: 像任何其他应用程序一样打开您每天使用的工件，并让它们在您的计算机上执行更多操作。在适用于Mac和Windows的 Claude 中推出测试版。从今天开始，你可以使用 Claude 项目来创建、运行和共享桌面应用程序。“作为应用程序安装” 功能在Mac和Windows的 Claude 中推出测试版。当工件安装为Mac或Windows应用程序时，它会获得自己的图标并在自己的窗口中打开，而不是在 Claude 内打开。您可以与其他人共享它，它需要您的许可才能与您的计算机交互。您可以自行决定允许的额度。每个应用都可以使用 Claude 和您的连接器，并且在编辑基础工件时会自动更新。这简化了为知识工作者和开发人员构建和维护应用程序的过程。
articles.summary_en: Open the artifacts you use every day like any other app, and let them do more on your computer. Rolling out in beta in Claude for Mac and Windows. Starting today, you can use Claude artifacts to create, run, and share desktop apps. The "Install as app" feature is rolling out in beta in Claude for Mac and Windows. When an artifact is installed as a Mac or Windows app, it gets its own icon and opens in its own window instead of inside Claude. You can share it with others, and it needs your permission before it can interact with your computer. You choose how much to allow. Each app can use Claude and your connectors, and it updates automatically when the underlying artifact is edited. This simplifies the process for building and maintaining apps for both knowledge workers and developers.

articles.title_en: MCP servers can now ship skills, run tasks, and more with Claude
articles.title_zh: MCP服务器现在可以使用 Claude 提供技能、运行任务等

articles.summary_en: Skills over MCP is in public beta in Claude, so MCP servers can ship skills alongside their tools. Tasks and Elicitation are now generally available, and File Uploads is rolling out soon. Skills over MCP is now in public beta in Claude, so MCP servers can ship skills alongside their tools. We're also giving servers ways to handle longer, more interactive work with Claude: Tasks and Elicitation are now generally available, and File Uploads is rolling out soon. Two years ago, Anthropic launched the Model Context Protocol (MCP) as a new standard for connecting AI agents to the systems where data lives. articles.title_en: Working with AI
articles.title_zh: 与AI合作
articles.summary_zh: 我们采访了58家使用 Claude 的公司的员工，了解AI如何改变他们的工作。他们描述了很少的裁员，但减少了招聘，并表示人工智能最有价值的用途通常涉及围绕它重组角色和工作场所。各行各业的企业如何应用人工智能？他们面临哪些瓶颈和挑战？雇主如何围绕能力越来越强的模型重组人类的专业知识？为了更好地了解企业的体验，我们对 Anthropic 的58位企业客户进行了66次访谈。我们发现: LLMs的使用在整个经济中呈爆炸式增长。人类组织如何重塑这些奇怪的新合作者？想想我们采访过的一家中型律师事务所的一名员工。
articles.summary_en: We interviewed people at 58 companies that use Claude about how AI is changing their work. They described few layoffs but reduced hiring, and said the most valuable uses of AI often involved reorganizing roles and workplaces around it. How are businesses across the economy adopting AI? What bottlenecks and challenges have they faced? How can employers reorganize human expertise around increasingly capable models? To understand businesses’ experiences better, we conducted 66 interviews with 58 of Anthropic’s enterprise customers. We found: The use of LLMs has exploded across the economy. How are human organizations reshaping around these strange new collaborators? Consider an employee at a midsize law firm that we spoke to.

Coding agents likely write code and open pull requests at your organization already. For many leading enterprises, they are reviewing, testing, and merging it too. For example, after standardizing on Claude Code across its engineering organization, Salesforce ¹ reported : As agents do more, technical and security leaders must mitigate risks like prompt injection and privilege abuse with layered controls such as checked permissions and bounded environments. The first two chapters focus on scoping the risk. We discuss the requirements every AI provider should meet and four agentic risks to mitigate.

articles.title_en: Claude Fable 5.2 solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
articles.title_zh: Claude 寓言5.2解决了黑洞物理学中的两个公开问题
articles.summary_zh: Claude Fable 5.2已经解决了理论物理学中的两个未解问题。两者都涉及黑洞以及对量子引力理论的探索。现代物理学建立在两大理论框架之上：广义相对论和量子力学。广义相对论描述的是非常大的物体，比如恒星；量子力学则描述的是非常小的物体，例如原子。两者在预测宇宙行为方面都表现出惊人的准确性，但在数学上却互不相容。寻找一种能够将它们统一起来的理论——“量子引力”——是该领域最重要的目标之一。黑洞是一个天然的实验场，因为它们是为数不多的相对论与量子力学都至关重要的领域之一——它们将巨大的质量压缩到极小的空间中。
articles.summary_en: Claude Fable 5.2 has solved two open problems in theoretical physics. Both concern black holes and the search for a theory of quantum gravity. Modern physics rests on two frameworks: general relativity and quantum mechanics. General relativity describes very large things, like stars; quantum mechanics describes very small things, such as atoms. Both are astonishingly good at predicting how the universe behaves, but they’re mathematically incompatible. Finding a theory that unites them—“quantum gravity”—is one of the field’s biggest goals. Black holes are a natural testing ground, because they’re one of the few areas where both relativity and quantum mechanics matter—they pack immense mass into a very small space.

articles.title_en: Linked billing on the Claude Platform
articles.title_zh: Claude 平台上的关联账单
articles.summary_zh: 关联计费现已在 Claude 平台上推出测试版。第三方平台可以让客户在不共享 API 密钥的情况下支付 Claude API 的使用费用。今天，我们将在 Claude 平台上以测试版形式推出关联计费功能。第三方平台（如编码代理和工作流自动化工具）可以让其最终客户为 Claude API 的使用付费，而无需共享 API 密钥。最终客户保留其现有的Anthropic计费方式并自行设定支出限额，而平台则获得一种更简便、更安全的方式来提供Claude。在第三方平台上为 Claude API 的使用付费，通常意味着需要共享一个 API 密钥，该密钥的作用类似于密码：任何持有该密钥的人都可以发起由客户付费的请求，因此平台必须妥善保管该密钥。
articles.summary_en: Linked billing is now in beta on the Claude Platform. Third-party platforms can let customers pay for Claude API usage without sharing an API key. Today we're introducing linked billing on the Claude Platform in beta. Third-party platforms, such as coding agents and workflow automation tools, can let their end customers pay for Claude API usage without sharing an API key. End customers keep their existing Anthropic billing and set their own spend limits, and platforms get a simpler, more secure way to offer Claude. Paying for Claude API usage on a third-party platform usually means sharing an API key, which works like a password: anyone who has the key can make requests billed to the customer, so the platform has to keep it safe.

articles.title_en: How the Claude Code team thinks about verification / claude.dev Blog
articles.title_zh: Claude 代码团队如何看待验证/claude.Dev博客
articles.summary_zh: 端到端，属性和差异测试如何让编码代理使用证据来验证其工作，以及 Claude 代码团队如何使其验证者保持诚实。在 Claude 代码团队中，绝大多数代码 (~ 90%) 由 Claude 编写和审核。在这一规模下，我们如何为一线工作人员配备工具，以便他们能够以证据核实工作成果，就显得尤为重要。验证循环是允许您将更多工作委托给 Claude 的构建块。如果没有它们，您实际上一次只能运行一两个 Claudes，因为您必须自己检查所有内容。有了它们，您可以并行运行数十甚至数百个。那是因为给代理商一种验证其输出的方法是提高质量的有效方法。
articles.summary_en: How end-to-end, property and differential tests let coding agents verify their work with evidence, and what the Claude Code team does to keep its verifiers honest. On the Claude Code team, the vast majority of our code (~90%) is written and reviewed by Claude . At this scale, how we equip our agents to verify their work with evidence becomes extremely important. Verification loops are the building block that lets you delegate more work to Claude. Without them, you can really only run one or two Claudes at a time, because you have to check everything yourself. With them, you can run dozens or hundreds in parallel. Thatâs because giving agents a way to verify their output is an effective way to improve quality.

articles.title_en: Updating our coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy timelines
articles.title_zh: 更新我们的协调漏洞披露政策时间表
articles.summary_zh: 对于严重和严重的问题，我们正在将漏洞披露窗口从90天缩短到30天，对于所有其他问题则缩短到45天。在过去的几个月中，前沿模型在发现漏洞方面变得更好。我们仍然乐观地认为，这将有助于防御者比以往更快地发现和修复漏洞。然而，人工智能改进的速度已经改变了我们对自己的信息披露实践的看法。我们正在将我们的协调漏洞披露 (CVD) 政策中的披露窗口从90天缩短到30天，对于严重和严重问题，将所有其他问题缩短到45天。新的时间表适用于在2027年1月1日时或之后向供应商和维护人员报告的漏洞。
articles.summary_en: We’re shortening our vulnerability disclosure window from 90 days to 30 days for high- and critical-severity issues, and to 45 days for all other issues. Over the last several months, frontier models have become much better at discovering vulnerabilities . We remain optimistic that this will help defenders find and fix vulnerabilities faster than ever before. However, the speed at which AI is improving has changed how we think about our own disclosure practices. We’re shortening the disclosure window in our coordinated vulnerability disclosure (CVD) policy from 90 days to 30 days for high- and critical-severity issues, and to 45 days for all other issues. The new timelines apply to vulnerabilities reported to vendors and maintainers on or after January 1, 2027.

articles.title_en: Building strong safety evaluations
articles.title_zh: 建立强有力的安全评估
articles.summary_zh: 根据我们自己的经验，设计、运行和报告安全评估的建议。安全评估为我们对人工智能模型做出的一些最重要的决定提供了信息，包括它是否准备好部署，它旁边的保障措施，以及我们下一轮的安全培训和研究应该关注什么。当我们说一个模型 “比它的前辈更安全” 时，我们的意思是它在某人构建的一组evals上得分更高。但是，安全声明仅与背后的评估一样合理，而好的声明很难建立。安全评估衡量模型造成或造成损害的倾向，无论其对请求的响应是否使损害的可能性增加或减少，以及损害的严重程度，而不是衡量特定的能力。
articles.summary_en: Recommendations for designing, running, and reporting safety evaluations, based on our own experiences. Safety evaluations inform some of the most consequential decisions we make about an AI model, including whether it’s ready to deploy, which safeguards ship alongside it, and what our next round of safety training and research should focus on. When we say a model is “safer than its predecessor,” we mean that it scored better on a set of evals someone built. But a safety claim is only as sound as the eval behind it, and good ones are hard to build. A safety eval measures a model’s propensity to cause or contribute to harm, whether its response to a request makes harm more or less likely, and how severe that harm would be, rather than measuring specific capabilities.

articles.title_en: Diluting Poisoned Fine-Tuning Data Can Strengthen Its Effect
articles.title_zh: 稀释中毒的微调数据可以增强其效果
articles.summary_zh: ¹ Anthropic; ² 真实AI; ³ NASK国家研究所; ² 华沙理工大学; ² MATS; 弗莱堡大学; 加州大学伯克利分校 * 核心贡献 † 詹姆斯: 在真实AI完成的工作; 西蒙: 在MATS完成的工作我们发现，一旦添加了干净的对比数据，对自己影响很小的中毒训练数据就可以创建一个隐藏的后门。我们在对我们构建的数据集进行微调的小模型中展示了这种效果。作为 Anthropic 研究员计划的一部分，与trufine AI合作完成的工作。我们研究了顺势学习，这是一种现象，一旦添加了干净的对比数据，中毒的训练数据对自己的影响很小，就可以创建一个隐藏的后门。

articles.title_en: Claude can design electronic prototypes from start to finish
articles.title_zh: Claude 可以从头到尾设计电子原型

articles.summary_en: We asked Claude to design three electronic devices: a speakerphone, a voice-assistant hub, and a handheld virtual pet. The prototypes worked without any fixes to their circuitry. We collaborated with Diode Computers , 1 a company that designs and manufactures circuit boards, to train Claude on simple tasks—for example, on reading a chip’s datasheet and working out which parts a chip needs in order to run. The models we experimented with back then couldn’t reliably lay out a circuit board; they also struggled to design components that fit together. Now, Claude can both design and prototype electronic hardware from start to finish.

articles.title_en: Safely scaling multi-agent teams with Claude Fable 5.2 / claude.dev Blog

articles.summary_zh: 一支由1000名工作人员组成的团队，在运行Claude Fable 5.2早期版本的环境下，借助通用工具、共享数据库以及多层安全防护机制，成功复现了费马大定理的形式化证明。多智能体团队能够解决具有挑战性的长周期问题。今年九月，我们发表了费马大定理的首个端到端形式化证明，该证明由数十个智能体在内部研究模型上完成，该模型大致相当于Claude Fable 5.1。该项工作依托于Prove2Me——一个用于形式化数学的平台——以及一位研究人员的指导。在一项新的玩具实验中，由1000个智能体组成的团队运行了Claude《寓言》5.2的早期版本，在没有Prove2Me提供的支撑框架、也未接受研究人员指导的情况下，重现了该证明。

Multi-agent teams can solve challenging, long-horizon problems. In September , we published the first end-to-end formalization of Fermatâs Last Theorem, written by dozens of agents running an internal research model roughly comparable to Claude Fable 5.1. That work relied on Prove2Me, a platform for formalizing mathematics, and direction from a researcher. In a new toy experiment, a team of 1,000 agents running an early version of Claude Fable 5.2 reproduced the proof without the scaffolding provided by Prove2Me or steering from a researcher.

articles.title_en: Which Claude model should you build with? Fable, Opus, Sonnet, or Haiku / claude.dev Blog

articles.summary_zh: 当前的 Claude 阵容有四种通用型号: Claude Haiku 5.5，Claude Sonnet 5.5，Claude Opus 5.5和 Claude 寓言5.2。Claude Mythos 5.2是我们最有能力的网络安全和生命科学研究模型，可通过我们的验证计划获得。如果您在 Claude 平台上构建或使用 Claude 代码，您可能想知道使用哪种模型来完成常见任务。这篇文章将帮助回答这个问题，以及如何思考权衡。简而言之，您应该将大多数工作在 Opus 5.5上以默认的中等努力程度开始。它之所以成为 Claude Code中的默认模型，是有原因的。每个输入和输出令牌的成本是寓言5.2的一半，这是我们建议从大多数编码和知识工作开始的模型。
articles.summary_en: The current Claude lineup has four generally available models: Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.2. Claude Mythos 5.2 is our most capable model for cybersecurity and life sciences research, available through our verification programs. If you build on the Claude Platform or work in Claude Code, you may be wondering which model to use for your common tasks. This article will help answer that question and how to think about the trade-offs. The quick answer is that you should start most work on Opus 5.5 at its default effort level, medium . There's a reason it's the default model in Claude Code. It costs half as much per input and output token as Fable 5.2, and it's the model we recommend starting with for most coding and knowledge work.

articles.title_en: Teaching AI to build scientific models
articles.title_zh: 教AI建立科学模型
articles.summary_zh: 科学的AI资助人Jakob Macke，Daniel Gedon和Stefan Wahl谈到了AI如何开始改变科学模型的构建和解释方式。1951年，剑桥大学的计算机停止运行了六个月。这对生理学家安德鲁·赫胥黎来说是不方便的，他和他的同事艾伦·霍奇金刚刚建立了一组方程来描述特定的鱿鱼神经细胞是如何发射的。科学家们想了解这些神经细胞的 “动作电位”: 它们用来交流的电脉冲，这是大脑从感知到智力所做的一切事情的基础。找出方程是否有效的唯一方法是求解它们并将解与数据进行比较。赫胥黎曾希望使用新型计算机来求解方程。
articles.summary_en: AI for Science grantees Jakob Macke, Daniel Gedon, and Stefan Wahl on how AI is starting to change how scientific models are built and interpreted. In 1951, Cambridge University’s computer went out of action for six months. This was inconvenient for physiologist Andrew Huxley, who, alongside his colleague Alan Hodgkin, had just built a set of equations to describe how a particular squid nerve cell fired. The scientists wanted to understand the “action potential” of these nerve cells: the electrical pulses they use to communicate, which underlie everything brains do, from perception to intelligence. The only way to find out whether the equations worked was to solve them and compare the solutions to data. Huxley had hoped to use the newfangled computer to solve the equations.

articles.title_en: The components of agent memory
articles.title_zh: 代理内存的组件
articles.summary_zh: Claude 要从经验中学习，它必须先决定什么是值得记住的，然后才能知道下一步是什么。以下是 “做梦” 如何帮助它组织记忆和纠正错误。S ø renkierkegaard写道，生活只能向后理解，但必须向前生活。在为AI代理设计内存时，我们遇到了类似的绑定。作为人类，我们在生活中不断编码记忆。海马体在这方面起着核心作用，捕捉当下的经历，以便记忆快速形成并立即可用。但是只有一些经验被整合成长期的知识。大部分整合似乎发生在我们的大脑离线时。当我们睡觉时，在安静的休息中，海马体会重放我们最近的经历。
articles.summary_en: For Claude to learn from experience, it has to decide what’s worth remembering before it knows what’s next. Here’s how “dreaming” helps it organize memory and correct mistakes. Søren Kierkegaard wrote that life can only be understood backward , but it must be lived forward . We’ve encountered a similar bind when designing memory for AI agents. As humans, we encode memory constantly as we go about our lives. The hippocampus plays a central role in this, capturing experiences in the moment so that memories form quickly and are immediately available. But only some experiences are consolidated into long-term knowledge. Much of that consolidation appears to happen when our brains are offline. As we sleep, and during quiet rest , the hippocampus replays our recent experiences.

articles.title_en: Project EVE: Claude plays MMORPGs
articles.title_zh: 夏娃计划: Claude 扮演mmorpg
articles.summary_zh: 我们将 Claude 放在两个EVE游戏中，研究AI代理商如何处理市场和团队合作，他们在哪里崩溃，以及他们可能需要什么保障措施。这篇文章分享了作为 Anthropic 2026年4月到7月研究员计划的一部分所做的研究。人工智能模型有一天可能会参与到真正的公司和市场中，我们的几个项目探索了它可能是什么样子。Claude 在我们的办公室经营一家商店，代表同事讨价还价，并编写了驾驶无人机的代码。在这个项目中，我们转向了一个不同的设置: 大型多人在线角色扮演游戏 (mmorpg)。Mmorpg是虚拟世界，在许多方面反映了现实世界的复杂性。
articles.summary_en: We put Claude in two EVE games to study how AI agents handle markets and teamwork, where they break down, and what safeguards they might need. This post shares research done as part of the Anthropic Fellows Program, April–July 2026. AI models may one day participate in real companies and markets, and several of our projects explored what that might look like. Claude has run a shop in our office , haggled on behalf of colleagues , and written code to fly a drone . In this project, we turned to a different setting: massively multiplayer online role-playing games (MMORPGs). MMORPGs are virtual worlds that in many ways reflect the complexity of the real world.

articles.title_en: How scientists use Claude
articles.title_zh: 科学家如何使用 Claude
articles.summary_zh: 在此报告中，我们使用隐私保护基础设施来研究 Claude, Claude 代码和 Claude 科学的科学使用。我们记录了科学领域和研究任务的使用情况如何变化，确定了解释这些使用模式的原因，并概述了人工智能如何加速研究的场景。Johannes Hermle *，Ben Jones *，Lukas Althoff *，Ryan Heller，Thomas Lyttelton，Carolyn Stein，Nathan Wilmers，Maxim Massenkoff，Peter McCrory科学被描述为 “无尽的边疆” (布什1945)。然而，历史上，我们探索这一前沿领域的速度一直受到一种稀缺资源的制约：即人类研究人员的时间与才能。
articles.summary_en: In this report, we use privacy-preserving infrastructure to study the scientific use of Claude, Claude Code, and Claude Science. We document how usage varies across scientific fields and research tasks, identify what explains these usage patterns, and outline scenarios for how AI could accelerate research. Johannes Hermle*, Ben Jones*, Lukas Althoff*, Ryan Heller, Thomas Lyttelton, Carolyn Stein, Nathan Wilmers, Maxim Massenkoff, Peter McCrory Science has been described as an “endless frontier” (Bush 1945). But how fast we explore that frontier has historically been limited by a scarce resource: the time and talent of human researchers.

articles.summary_en: Ask Claude about your money and get straight answers from the accounts you connect. Getting answers about your money no longer means opening every banking app and doing the math yourself. With Personal Finance in Claude, you can securely connect your bank and card accounts and ask in your own words. Access is read-only, and Personal Finance can’t move, manage, or invest your money. Claude gives you answers in everyday language, from your balances and transactions, and explains any term that's new to you. Like the rest of Claude , Personal Finance has no ads or sponsored recommendations, and it doesn’t offer credit cards, loans, or savings accounts of its own, so your money questions get a straight answer.

articles.title_en: Investigating vault particles with Claude
articles.title_zh: 调查 Claude 的拱顶颗粒
articles.summary_zh: 我们分享了 Anthropic 生物研究实验室的另一个发现: 在原核细胞中发现的第一个穹顶颗粒的3D结构。首先在1665中发现了生物细胞，但是三个半世纪后，它们的工作原理仍然未知。直到最近，一些关键组件的存在还是有争议的，更不用说它们的功能了。即使在今天，在研究最全面的细胞之一大肠杆菌中，大约4,400个基因中的三分之一以上仍然知之甚少。另一个这样的谜是拱顶粒子。穹窿颗粒是一种巨大的中空蛋白质外壳，几乎存在于我们体内的所有细胞中。伦纳德·罗马和南希·凯德沙1986年发现了它，但它的功能仍然难以捉摸。
articles.summary_en: We’re sharing another finding from Anthropic’s biology research lab: the first 3D structure of a vault particle found in prokaryotic cells. Biological cells were first detected in 1665, but more than three and a half centuries later, much of how they work remains unknown. Until relatively recently, the existence of some crucial components , let alone their function , was controversial. Even today, more than a third of the roughly 4,400 genes in one of the most comprehensively studied cells, the bacterium E. coli , remain poorly understood . Another such enigma is the vault particle . A vault particle is a large, hollow protein shell found in nearly all the cells in our body. It was discovered in 1986 by Leonard Rome and Nancy Kedersha, but its function remains elusive.

articles.title_en: Latency Optimization on the Claude API | Claude Cookbook

articles.summary_zh: 通过在实际评估中测试 Claude API 的每个延迟杠杆，找到仍然符合您的准确性要求的最快的代理配置。优化 LLM 工作负载是质量、成本和延迟之间的平衡。我们的大多数食谱都涵盖了输出质量，而成本优化食谱 (在新选项卡中打开) 涵盖了支出。这是关于让您的 Claude 供电的体验尽可能快。您可能需要更低的延迟来提供实时产品体验，例如呼叫中心语音代理。您可能有时间敏感的依赖关系，例如必须在付款授权超时之前清除的欺诈检查。或者，花费的时间越长，结果可能会失去价值，例如在市场反应之前为交易者总结收益电话。
articles.summary_en: Find the fastest agent configuration that still meets your accuracy bar by testing each of the Claude API's latency levers on a real eval. Optimizing LLM workloads is a balancing act between quality, cost, and latency. Most of our cookbooks cover output quality, and the cost optimization cookbook (opens in new tab) covers spend. This one is about making your Claude-powered experience as fast as possible. You might need lower latency to deliver a real-time product experience, like a call center voice agent. You might have time-sensitive dependencies, like a fraud check that has to be cleared before payment authorization times out. Or the result might lose value the longer it takes, such as in summarizing an earnings call for traders before the market reacts.

articles.title_en: Dreaming with a dynamic workflow | Claude Cookbook
articles.title_zh: 用动态工作流做梦 | Claude Cookbook
articles.summary_zh: 为你的经纪人建立一个小小的工作梦想。托管代理动态工作流读取已完成的会话，将其提取到wiki风格的内存存储中，以便将来的会话以只读方式安装，并且可以每天晚上从cron运行。你的代理运行许多会话，当每个会话启动时，它什么都不知道。做梦是一种背景通行证，可以事后回顾过去的成绩单和笔记，并改善将来的记忆。这本食谱是你适应的一个小工作梦想。您可以选择它何时运行，读取哪些成绩单，以及如何处理它们 (使其成为您的，接近尾声，列出设置)。
articles.summary_en: Build a small working dream for your agents. A Managed Agents dynamic workflow reads finished sessions, distills them into a wiki-style memory store that future sessions mount read-only, and can run every night from cron. Your agents run many sessions, and when each one starts it knows nothing. Dreaming is a background pass that looks back over past transcripts and notes with hindsight and improves the memory future sessions read: it can correct what turned out to be wrong, build a representation that's easier to search, and keep what matters within easy reach. This cookbook is a small working dream for you to adapt. You choose when it runs, which transcripts it reads, and what it does with them ( Make it yours , near the end, lists the settings).
